executionSteps.explanationEnglish: factorial(0): base case! Return 1. Stack unwinds now.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: factorial(0) base case! Return 1. Stack ab unwind hogi.

dsa_graph_basics.learningObjective: Learn Graph Theory basics: Vertices, Edges, Edge Weights, Neighbor Nodes, Degree, Adjacency Matrix & Adjacency List representations.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Graph G = (V, E): 7 Vertices V = {0..6} connected by 9 Edges E.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Graph G = (V, E): 7 Vertices V = {0..6} aur 9 Edges E ka non-linear mesh network.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Vertices (Nodes): Spatial 2D coordinates (x, y) representing entities (Cities/Routers).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Vertices (Nodes): 2D spatial positions jo network entities (Cities/Routers) ko represent karti hain.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Neighbors & Degree: Node [0] connects to neighbors [1, 2, 3] → Degree(0) = 3.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Neighbors & Degree: Node [0] ke directly connected neighbors [1, 2, 3] hain → Degree(0) = 3.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Edge Weights: Distance/latency values on connections (e.g. Node 0 ↔ Node 1 = 4).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Edge Weights: Node 0 se connected edges ke weights (e.g. w(0,1)=4, w(0,2)=2, w(0,3)=5).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Adjacency Matrix: V×V 2D Grid where M[u][v] stores edge weight/connection status.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Adjacency Matrix: 7×7 ka 2D Grid jahan M[u][v] edge weight ya connection presence store karta hai.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Adjacency List: Array of linked vectors storing adj[u] → (v, weight) for optimal space.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Adjacency List: Memory-efficient list structure jahan adj[u] har node ke neighbors store karta hai.

dsa_graph_bfs.learningObjective: Observe level-order search via Queue. Visual walkthrough shows visited nodes status, active Queue elements, and path construction step-by-step.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: BFS begins on Graph 1 (5 Nodes). Select start node A.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Graph 1 par BFS shuru hua. Start node select karein (A).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Enqueue start node A into the BFS Queue.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Start node A ko BFS Queue me enqueue kiya.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Dequeue curr = A. Visited path is appended: [A].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Queue se pop/dequeue kiya curr = A. Visited path: [A].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Enqueue neighbors B and C of node A.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: A ke neighbors B aur C ko queue me add kiya.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Dequeue next node curr = B from Front. Processed: [A, B].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Queue ke front se B ko dequeue kiya. Processed: [A, B].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: B has unvisited neighbor D. Enqueue D.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: B ka unvisited neighbor D hai. D ko queue kiya.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Dequeue next node curr = C. Processed: [A, B, C].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Queue se C ko dequeue kiya. Processed: [A, B, C].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Dequeue next node curr = D. Processed: [A, B, C, D].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Queue se D ko dequeue kiya. Processed: [A, B, C, D].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: D has neighbor E. Enqueue E.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: D ka neighbor E hai. E ko enqueue kiya.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Dequeue last node curr = E. Processed: [A, B, C, D, E]. Queue is empty.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: E ko dequeue kiya. Traversal complete! Path: [A, B, C, D, E].
executionSteps.consoleOutput: BFS Complete. Path: A -> B -> C -> D -> E

dsa_graph_dfs.learningObjective: Observe backtracking search via Stack. Walkthrough highlights stack contents, visiting depth, and backtrack routes step-by-step.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: DFS starts from selected node (e.g. A).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: DFS call stack shuru hui starting node A se.
A ko process kiya. Visited path: [A].
A ke neighbor B pe recursive call stack push kiya: DFS(B).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process B. Add to path: [A, B].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: B ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B].
B ke neighbor D pe call push kiya: DFS(D).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process D. Add to path: [A, B, D].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: D ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D].
D ke neighbor E pe call stack push: DFS(E).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process E. Add to path: [A, B, D, E].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: E ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D, E].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: E has no unvisited neighbors. Backtrack: pop DFS(E).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: E ke saare neighbors visited hain. Backtrack kiya: pop DFS(E).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Back at D, explore other neighbor: DFS(C).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: D ke other neighbor C pe stack push: DFS(C).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process C. Add to path: [A, B, D, E, C].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: C ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D, E, C].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: All remaining elements visited. Pop remaining frames. DFS complete.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Sabhi nodes visited ho gaye. Remaining call stacks pop kiya. DFS complete!
executionSteps.consoleOutput: DFS Complete. Path: A -> B -> D -> E -> C

A ke neighbor B pe recursive call stack push kiya: DFS(B).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process B. Add to path: [A, B].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: B ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B].
B ke neighbor D pe call push kiya: DFS(D).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process D. Add to path: [A, B, D].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: D ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D].
D ke neighbor E pe call stack push: DFS(E).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process E. Add to path: [A, B, D, E].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: E ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D, E].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: E has no unvisited neighbors. Backtrack: pop DFS(E).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: E ke saare neighbors visited hain. Backtrack kiya: pop DFS(E).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Back at D, explore other neighbor: DFS(C).
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: D ke other neighbor C pe stack push: DFS(C).

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Process C. Add to path: [A, B, D, E, C].
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: C ko process kiya. Visited path: [A, B, D, E, C].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: All remaining elements visited. Pop remaining frames. DFS complete.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Sabhi nodes visited ho gaye. Remaining call stacks pop kiya. DFS complete!
executionSteps.consoleOutput: DFS Complete. Path: A -> B -> D -> E -> C

dsa_heap_sort.learningObjective: Observe Max-Heap structures and tree root replacements to perform sorted element extraction.

executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Heap Sort shuru hua array ke sath: [12, 11, 13, 5, 6, 7].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Convert array to Max-Heap (Heapify): Max element 13 is moved to root index [0].

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Swap root 13 with last element 7 and extract 13.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Heapify remaining elements and extract root 12.
executionSteps.explanationHinglish: Bache huye elements ko heapify kiya aur root 12 extract kiya.

executionSteps.explanationEnglish: Repeat extraction steps until heap is empty. Sorted Array: [5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13].
